request.prompt: A single low-poly game-ready military signals intelligence post, a field work of a fictional army in plain matte olive-drab paint with dark gunmetal fittings and tan sandbags, clean and military. Compact square footprint about 6 by 6 metres, cabin 2.6 metres high, mast 9 metres high. Olive-painted steel, gunmetal lattice, tan sandbags. Plain even lighting, no baked shadows, no ground, no base, no plinth, centred, one object, door facing forward. No insignia, flags, text or markings of any kind.
